prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1399; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative. On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the traffic signal was green for their direction. Driver 2 was operating a pickup truck eastbound and stated that they entered the intersection after the light had changed. The front driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the passenger side of Driver 1's vehicle. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and reported no visible injuries at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Both vehicles sustained disabling damage and were towed from the scene. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Citation issued to Driver 2 for failure to obey a traffic control device. Statements were collected from all parties, and photographs were taken of the vehicles and intersection.
